exposure: Children born by normal vaginal delivery
Offspring of mothers without atopic diseases
Children born by other modes of delivery (e.g., emergency caesarean section)
Children born by elective caesarean section
Children born by assisted vaginal delivery
Offspring of mothers with atopic diseases
cohort: All children born between 2001 and 2006 and living in the province of South Karelia, Finland (N = 5564)
finding: By adolescence, the cumulative incidences of atopic sensitization were highest among those born by assisted vaginal delivery or caesarean section.
mod_finding: The incidence of food allergy was highest among those born by elective caesarean section among the offspring of mothers without atopic diseases.
